episodes.synopsis: On the first day of school, Ryūji discovers that he and Taiga, the meanest girl in class, share a secret: each loves the other's best friend.
episodes.title: Tiger and Dragon

episodes.synopsis: Taiga's efforts to get closer to Yūsaku fail: A scheme in basketball ends with Taiga knocked out, and she drops a plate of cookies out a window.
episodes.title: Taiga and Ryuji

episodes.synopsis: Ryūji and Taiga spend a day helping Minori at one of her many part-time jobs, and Ryūji gets to know her better when they're locked in a storehouse.
episodes.title: Your Song

episodes.synopsis: Taiga has a photo album full of blurry pictures of Kitamura. Ryūji offers to snap some pictures of him instead.
episodes.title: That Look You Had

episodes.synopsis: Yūsaku's childhood friend Ami, a model, transfers to the school and immediately becomes popular with everyone but Taiga, who sees the truth about her.
episodes.title: Kawashima Ami

episodes.synopsis: Followed by a stalker, Ami hides out with Taiga and decides that she must discard her fake personality from now on.
episodes.title: True Self

episodes.synopsis: When the school's pool opens for the summer, the gang shops for new swimsuits, and Ryūji helps Taiga with an embarrassing problem.
episodes.title: Pool's Open

episodes.synopsis: Ryūji tries to help Taiga win a swimming race against Ami, but when Ryūji nearly drowns, the truth about Taiga's feelings comes out.
episodes.title: Who Is This For?

episodes.synopsis: During a trip to Ami's beach villa, Taiga has a nightmare about being married to Ryūji and schemes to bring him and Minori together.
episodes.title: When You Go To The Sea

episodes.synopsis: The gang plots an elaborate stunt to scare Minori with a trip to a nearby cave where Yūsaku has planted scary traps, but Yūsaku and Minori disappear.
episodes.title: Fireworks

episodes.synopsis: As preparations get under way for the school's cultural festival, Ryūji urges Taiga to consider reconciling with her estranged father.
episodes.title: Ohashi High School Culture Festival 1

episodes.synopsis: Taiga's reconciliation with her father divides her friends, but she ends up disappointed when her father doesn't attend her school play.
episodes.title: Ohashi High School Culture Festival 2

episodes.synopsis: Taiga wins a beauty contest despite a crushing disappointment about her father; a race is held to determine who will dance with Taiga.
episodes.title: Ohashi High School Culture Festival 3

episodes.synopsis: A rumor starts that touching Taiga leads to good luck; Yūsaku gets some interesting news from the student council president.
episodes.title: Palm-top Tiger of Happiness

episodes.synopsis: Yūsaku has a meltdown in class, dyes his hair blond and refuses to run for student council, causing everyone to wonder what's wrong with him.
episodes.title: Distant Star

episodes.synopsis: Yūsaku reveals his love for Sumire, a student council president who is leaving to study abroad, so his friends urge him to run for her council seat.
episodes.title: One Step Forward

episodes.synopsis: With Christmas approaching, the student council plans a party while Taiga decides to curry favor with Santa by playing Cupid for Ryūji and Minori.
episodes.title: Mercury is Retrograde at Christmas

episodes.synopsis: The entire class pitches in to assemble an artificial Christmas tree with a glass star, but a stray fly ball destroys the decorations.
episodes.title: Underneath the Fir Tree

episodes.synopsis: The love triangle of Ryūji, Minori and Taiga reaches a crisis point when true feelings are realized during the school's Christmas Eve party.
episodes.title: Christmas Eve Party

episodes.synopsis: The class trip to Okinawa is canceled, leading to a last-minute change of plans to a ski trip, where Ryūji resolves to tell Minori how he feels.
episodes.title: Stay Like This Forever

episodes.synopsis: During the ski trip, Ryūji confesses his feelings for Minori, but not to her. When Taiga disappears, everyone frantically searches for her.
episodes.title: Can't Help Myself

episodes.synopsis: Knowing that Taiga believes she was rescued by Yūsaku during the ski trip, Ryūji asks Yūsaku to pretend that she's correct.
episodes.title: When You're Around

episodes.synopsis: When Yasuko collapses from anemia due to overwork, Ryūji and Taiga take over her job of selling chocolate and use Ami's celebrity to improve sales.
episodes.title: Path to Take

episodes.synopsis: The truth about Taiga and Ryūji's feelings for each other finally comes out, and they make a plan to run off together and get married.
episodes.title: Confession

episodes.synopsis: When Yasuko reconciles with her parents, the truth about Ryūji's father is revealed, inspiring him to have a traditional wedding with Taiga.
episodes.title: Toradora!
